words.sense: Existing in a person from birth rather than acquired through teaching or practice.
misconceptions: Treats any natural feature of a system as a birth trait.
Mistakes an acquired skill for a trait present from birth.

words.sense: Belonging essentially to the nature of a thing, arrangement, or activity.
misconceptions: Treats any natural feature of a system as a birth trait.
Mistakes an acquired skill for a trait present from birth.

semantic_axes.description: Innate describes a trait present in a person from birth; inherent describes a quality inseparable from a thing’s basic nature.

edges.boundary_rule: Innate describes a trait present in a person from birth; inherent describes a quality inseparable from a thing’s basic nature.

misconceptions.M1: Treats any natural feature of a system as a birth trait.
misconceptions.M2: Mistakes an acquired skill for a trait present from birth.
misconceptions.M3: Confuses being typical with being an essential feature.

chains.frame: Which word best describes baby Mina’s grasping response?

beats.text: Mina was just days old when her tiny hand closed around a finger placed in her palm.
beats.decisive_clue: the grasping response appeared in the first days of life
beats.reason: A response present in a newborn before teaching or practice is innate.

beats.text: She did it before anyone could teach her how.
beats.decisive_clue: the grasping response appeared before instruction
beats.reason: The response was present before learning or rehearsal, which supports innate.

chains.feedback_short: The grasping response appeared before instruction, in the first days of life.
chains.feedback_deep: Innate means existing in a person from birth rather than acquired through teaching or practice. Inherent means belonging essentially to the nature of a thing, arrangement, or activity. Mina's grasping response is innate because it appeared in the first days of life and before instruction.
chains.contrast_rule: Innate describes a trait or response present in a person from birth; inherent describes a quality inseparable from a thing’s basic nature.

hints.attention: Focus on when the response first appeared.

beats.text: Esra showed unusually accurate pitch in infancy, before she had received lessons or deliberate musical practice.
beats.decisive_clue: the musical ability was evident in infancy before teaching or practice
beats.reason: An ability evident from infancy before instruction is naturally described as innate.

beats.text: At five, she matched unfamiliar notes accurately without being shown where to place her fingers.
beats.decisive_clue: the later performance is consistent with an ability evident before instruction
beats.reason: This later performance does not change the key evidence that the ability was already present before teaching or practice.
